chunks: In the courtyard of his house, while the people were seated around him, they said: “We estimated that around him there were one hundred and fifty men from the family of Abī Ṭālib, Banī Hāshim, and Quraysh, besides his mawālī and the rest of the people.” Then he looked toward al-Ḥasan ibn ʿAlī, who had come with his collar torn, until he stood at his right side, and we did not know him. Then Abū al-Ḥasan عليه السلام looked at him after a while and said: “O my son, renew gratitude to Allah, Mighty and Majestic, for He has brought about in you a matter.”

So the youth wept, praised Allah, and recited the istirjāʿ, and said: “All praise belongs to Allah, Lord of the worlds, and I ask Allah for the completion of His blessings for us through you, and indeed we belong to Allah and indeed to Him we are returning.”

So we asked about him, and it was said: “This is al-Ḥasan, his son.” We estimated him at that time to be twenty years old or somewhat older. On that day, we came to know him and understood that he had indicated him for the Imamate and established him in his place.

key_terms.آلِ أَبِي طَالِبٍ: the family of Abū Ṭālib present among the gathering
key_terms.الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ: a formula of praise to Allah, Lord of all worlds
key_terms.بِالْإِمَامَةِ: with the Imamate, indicating divinely designated leadership
key_terms.شُكْرًا: gratitude to Allah for the divine matter conferred
key_terms.مَشْقُوقَ الْجَيْبِ: with his garment collar torn, a sign of mourning
key_terms.مَقَامَهُ: his station or place, meaning succession to his position
key_terms.وَإِنَّا لِلَّهِ وَإِنَّا إِلَيْهِ رَاجِ: the Quranic formula of return to Allah in affliction

ai.seo_question: How did Abū al-Ḥasan عليه السلام indicate the Imamate of al-Ḥasan ibn ʿAlī عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This report describes a public moment in which Abū al-Ḥasan عليه السلام signaled the succession of his son al-Ḥasan through a brief but weighty statement. The narration also preserves the son’s response of gratitude, praise, and istirjāʿ, after which those present recognized the indication toward his Imamate.

en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya and someone else, from Sa’ad Bin Abdullah, 
(It has been narrated) from a group of the Clan of Hashim<sup>as</sup>, from them being Al-Hassan Bin Al-Hassan Al-Aftas, that they were present, on the day Muhammad<sup>asws</sup> Bin Ali<sup>asws</sup> Bin Muhammad<sup>asws</sup> (9<sup>th</sup> Imam<sup>asws</sup>) passed away, at the door of Abu Al-Hassan<sup>asws</sup> (10<sup>th</sup> Imam<sup>asws</sup>) consoling him<sup>asws</sup>, and there had been extended for him<sup>asws</sup> in the courtyard of his<sup>asws</sup> house, and the people were seated around him<sup>asws</sup>. 
So they said, ‘We estimated that there would happen to be around him<sup>asws</sup> from the progeny of Abu Talib<sup>asws</sup> and the Clan of Hashim<sup>as</sup>, and Qureysh, one hundred and fifty men, besides his<sup>asws</sup> friends and the rest of the people. We looked at Al-Hassan<sup>asws</sup> Bin Ali<sup>asws</sup> who had come with a torn shirt until he<sup>asws</sup> stood on his<sup>asws</sup> right, and we did not know him<sup>asws</sup>. So Abu Al-Hassan<sup>asws</sup> looked at him<sup>asws</sup> after a while and he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘O my<sup>asws</sup> son<sup>asws</sup>! Renew thanks for Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic for the command (Imamate) has occurred in you<sup>asws</sup>’.

So the youth wept and Praised Allah<sup>azwj</sup> and said: ‘We are for Allah<sup>azwj</sup> and to Him<sup>azwj</sup> are we returning’, and said: ‘The Praise is for Allah<sup>azwj</sup>, Lord<sup>azwj</sup> of the words, and I<sup>asws</sup> ask Allah<sup>azwj</sup> for the completion of His<sup>azwj</sup> Bounties for us in you<sup>asws</sup>, and we are for Allah<sup>azwj</sup> and we are returning to Him<sup>azwj</sup>’.

So we asked about him<sup>asws</sup>, and it was said, ‘This is Al-Hassan<sup>asws</sup>, his<sup>asws</sup> son<sup>asws</sup>’, and we estimated for him<sup>asws</sup> at that time to be of twenty years or more. So it was in those days that we recognised him<sup>asws</sup> and we knew that he<sup>asws</sup> had indicated to him<sup>asws</sup> as being with the Imamate, and (had made) him<sup>asws</sup> stood in his<sup>asws</sup> own place’.
en.sarwar: 8. Muhammad ibn Yahya and others have narrated from Sa‘id ibn ‘Abdallah from a group of banu Hashim, among whom was al-Hassan ibn al-Hassan al-Aftas, the following. “They were present on the day Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Muhammad, at the door of abu al-Hassan to offer condolences. A place in the compound of his house was prepared for him and people were sitting around him. They said, “We estimated that at that time from the descendents of abu Talib, Hashim and Quraysh there were about fifty men besides his slaves and other people. At such time he look at al-Hassan ibn Ali coming and the front of his shirt was torn. He stood at the right of his father and we did not know him. Abu al-Hassan (a.s.) looked at him after a while and said, “My son, renew your thanks to Allah, the Most Majestic, the Most gracious, because He has granted you a new task (Leadership with Divine Authority).”

The young man wept, praised Allah, and said, “We are for Allah and to Him we shall return. He then said, “All praise belongs to Allah, Lord of the worlds. I pray to Allah for completion the blessings for us in you. “We are for Allah and to Him we shall return.”

We asked about him and it was said that he was al-Hassan, the son of the Imam. We estimated his age at that time around twenty years or more. On that day we learned and came to know that he had tacitly made a statement about the succeeding Imam and (the Leader with Divine Authority).”
